biotools.summary: StabLyzeGraph is a computational framework utilizing Graph Neural Networks to analyze and predict stabilizing mutations in proteins, accelerating rational protein design. It enables high-throughput screening of combinatorial mutations by integrating structural, physicochemical, and evolutionary data.
